connector.name: Agentlock
connector.registryDescription: Security gateway for AI agents: policy, approval, and audited execution, no secrets shared.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.agentlock.net over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the olum289 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: AgentLock API token as a Bearer credential (format: 'Bearer <token>'); create one in the dashboard.
